findings.result: Two actual source theorems jointly establish the whole necessary-condition target.
findings.proof: Q_D main can take at most one g in any positive partial allocation, so V=1/D. Complete normalized flat conversion gives OPT=2−1/D and the explicit lambda gives CONFIG1 for every job. In v3 at T=1, a=d and r=ceil(d/(μ+2)); d−μ(r−1)≥2r−1 and (2r−1)^h≥2r^h−1. The matched rainbow trees plus original-d backfill give C′≤2−r/d<2. Existence decode yields 2−1/D≤C′, hence Dr≤d, d≥D, μ≥D−2. Neither source alone pays the comparison.

findings.result: The compiler/decode contract is the antecedent of the proved necessary-condition theorem; accepted/unconditional does not assert a compiler exists.
findings.proof: For any finite nonempty target satisfying CONFIG1, v3 implies OPT′<2 and both finite assignment minima are attained. Applying decode to a target optimum proves OPT(Q_D)≤OPT′. Conversely a single source optimum works for every target low-peak schedule under that scalar inequality. No computable or uniform selection is used. Substitute any integer μ0≥actual μ; D>μ0+2 is impossible, and at equality D ceil(d/D)≤d iff D divides d, only necessary.

findings.result: The full transfer endpoint is E(P)=C(D(P)); no degree premise is omitted.
findings.proof: D replaces d_u incident groups by ports and d_u−1 actual helper groups, each with one selector plus two incidences. Every selected helper exports under C<2, so helpers occupy d_u−1 distinct ports; additional unselected exports only strengthen occupancy. C keeps old jobs at active z* and adds private0 tasks in all missing slice cells. Old-job extension/projection is legal for all jobs, including zero and unselected jobs. Compose in forward D then C order, reverse C then D. All-private baselines and attained minima close OPT=2. W=1 makes D normalized and lets C preserve every positive partial threshold; finite maxima close V=0.

findings.result: The stated 4h contribution and finite-entry count are correct.
findings.proof: D has n+h groups, a+2h states/private machines, p+u0 resources, n+L+3h jobs, and a+2L+6h finite entries. Each helper union has two ports and two states, so the C sum Kq adds 4 per helper. E has 27(p+u0+e) resource machines, a+2h private machines, n+h selectors, 9(T0+4h) incidences, n+h+9(T0+4h) total jobs, and a+2h+18(T0+4h) finite entries. p,h≤L and T0≤a max(1,|U|) make the total explicit bit-size polynomial.

findings.result: The edge correctly refuses preservation of original M and κ.
findings.proof: For two original one-state groups sharing r≥2 resources, every old weight is 1/r, so M=κ=1. D creates r helpers, each between the two old groups; each old group then has r distinct helper neighbors, and each port contains positive weights 1/r and 1. Therefore M=κ=r; C preserves this D graph and only adds zero weights.

findings.result: N binary-selector/port normal form and v3 uniform private trees are different models.
findings.proof: N has one selector per tree vertex/group, own singleton states of time1, altered original selector eligibility and subsequent shared ports. Binary topology does not impose global parent processing time1/2 or v3 private incoming structure. The parameter obstruction cannot be applied by identifying the pictures.

M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.title: CONFIG保真低峰解码的私有树参数障碍
M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.model: 源为全部原任务的normalized flat普通UM Q_D(D≥2整数)；目标为非空有限、全局d,h≥1、每root非空indexed菜单、各state满d叉高h完全私有内部机的v3普通UM。root selector unit；内部job父端1/d及子端1，leaf job父端1/d及唯一unit外端，外部可跨root/state共享，无其它jobs、预载或资格。μ为每完整state最大叶资源重数。
M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.statement: 对每个D≥2和此域目标P′，若完整CONFIG(1)可行且每份峰C<2的完整目标实际调度均存在峰不增的完整Q_D调度解码，则D·ceil(d/(μ+2))≤d，故d≥D、μ≥D−2。该域内低峰解码合同等价于OPT(Q_D)≤OPT(P′)。若仅已知μ≤μ0，可代入μ0得同式；D>μ0+2不可能，D=μ0+2还必有D整除d，但这些只为必要条件。固定d0亦排D>d0，故固定μ0或固定d0的该类编译不能覆盖全部Q_D。
M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.quantifiers: ∀整数D≥2，∀所列显式非空完整P′(全局整数d,h≥1、实际重数μ≥1)，在CONFIG1和低峰完整解码前件下给参数必要条件；无需统一或可计算映射、前向实际调度保持、高峰解码或复杂性假设。
assumptions: CONFIG1覆盖所有原jobs，不能只保selected子实例；source Q_D各state质量1且OPT=2−1/D。
目标严格在v3完全私有、统一父端时间1/d、唯一单位叶外端结构内；d既是统一分叉数又指定该处理时间。
解码输出安排源全部原jobs且峰不增；只需要目标C<2域，不要求算法性。
参数界仅必要；低峰解码与单向OPT不等式的等价利用目标CONFIG1→OPT′<2及有限最优值达到。
M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.scope: Q_D与已证配置上界共同给具体结构编译的必要参数增长。准确切断同时保CONFIG1和峰不增低峰解码的固定μ或固定d路线；不否定N二叉selector/port正规形，不推出一般UM hardness、一般近二近似不可能、参数充分性或锐利性。
M-4bfb99ccca4f4f77a6aaee6882ef1170.objections: Haxell/私有树存在定理按v3的既有已证合同调用，未重证外部文献或宣称位多项式输出σ。共享内部机、异构树、非均匀时间、多单位叶端、额外任务/预载、有损解码及不保CONFIG1均须另作比较。独立批内核对与root全任务重算一致，无新增有限枚举。

UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.title: 每完整state叶重数μ的rainbow阻断与全CONFIG离二存在界
UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.model: 普通UM的显式完全私有满d叉高h状态树；每root非空状态菜单和一枚unit selector，每edge父端1/d、唯一内部child或叶外机端1；其余∞，无预载/其它任务；全部未选state和inactive原任务也必须执行。每完整state任一真实外机叶逆像≤μ；跨state/root共享任意。
UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.statement: 局部满a树存在ceil(a/μ)叉rainbow；若μ(r−1)<a，命中全部rainbow r树的资源X满足|f^−1(X)|≥[a−μ(r−1)]^h。共同full-state λ容量及该量≥2r^h−1给全root不交rainbow选择。由CONFIG(T)精确边际构造a=d−floor(d(T−1))叉辅助分布，取r=ceil(a/(μ+2))，完整原P存在C≤2−r/d≤(2−1/(μ+2))T。所有阈值补T≥2基线，CONFIG gap≤2−1/(μ+2)。
UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.quantifiers: ∀整数d,h,μ≥1、全部显式菜单P；∀有理T∈[1,2)的可行CONFIG；∀满足精确blocker条件r。
assumptions: μ是每完整state实际重数上界，不是总共享重数
阻断数计逆像叶重数，与同一λ容量相接不额外除μ
辅助a-tree不改原d或时间1/d
Haxell仅有限存在性
UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.scope: 固定μ才得统一离二常数，μ1为5/3、μ2为7/4，均未称锐。
UM-Q-PRIVATE-TREE-BOUNDED-MULTIPLICITY-C.objections: 全部未选/零λstate与未选枝jobs须回填。可能指数多辅助states/超边，不是uniform位多项式σ构造；不对一般UM扩域。
